character.name: Idle
character.prompt: A young hunter standing in a grounded, ready stance, wearing a hooded leather cloak over a fitted tunic and rugged trousers. He has tousled curly brown hair visible beneath the hood and an alert, focused expression. He holds a recurve bow in one hand and has a quiver of feathered arrows strapped across his back. The attire features textured leather straps, brass buckles, and layered fabric, rendered with a crisp black outline and a naturalistic, earthy color palette of forest green, deep brown, and tan.
